item.title: Old water mains replaced in Ballyshannon
item.description: Four hundred metres of ageing water mains have been replaced in Ballyshannon. The works were carried out as part of the National Leakage Reduction Programme. The project also included installing new water service connections from the public water main to customer boundaries, further strengthening the local supply.
